actions.description: Fetch the IoCs matching the provided IoC value from the Flashpoint Technical Intelligence v2 API, narrowed by the available filters

ioc_value.description: Plain-text value to match against the IoC values. A value wrapped in double quotes is matched exactly, an unquoted value is matched partially

ioc_types.description: Comma-separated list of IoC types to match (allowed values: domain, extracted_config, file, ipv4, ipv6, url)

size.description: Maximum number of IoCs to be fetched in one request (default: 10, maximum: 1000, maximum: 500 when 'embed' is provided)

from.description: Zero-based index of the first IoC to be fetched (default: 0)

cidr_range.description: CIDR range to match against the ipv4 or ipv6 IoC values

tags.description: Comma-separated list of exact IoC tags to match, for example malware:asprox, actor:ta505, os:windows or report:004W2YABmBdJgq5I9VMh

sources.description: Comma-separated list of exact source tags to match, for example flashpoint_extraction, flashpoint_apt or external_intelligence (the 'source:' prefix is optional)

actors.description: Comma-separated list of exact actor tags to match (the actor tag prefix is optional)

malware.description: Comma-separated list of exact malware tags to match (the 'malware:' prefix is optional)

mitre_attack_ids.description: Comma-separated list of MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs to match, for example T1041

min_score.description: Minimum score tier of the IoCs to be fetched

max_score.description: Maximum score tier of the IoCs to be fetched

has_intel_report.description: Fetch only the IoCs that have an associated intelligence report

has_extracted_config.description: Fetch only the IoCs that have an associated extracted configuration

embed.description: Comma-separated list of additional fields to embed in the response (allowed values: all, apt_description, external_references, malware_description, mitre_attack_ids, related_iocs). Providing this parameter caps the response at 500 IoCs

last_seen_after.description: Include IoCs last seen on or after this date. Supports an absolute datetime (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z), a date (2024-01-01) or a relative value (-30d, -8h, +1w)

last_seen_before.description: Include IoCs last seen before this date. Supports an absolute datetime (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z), a date (2024-01-01) or a relative value (-30d, -8h, +1w)

created_after.description: Include IoCs created on or after this date. Supports an absolute datetime (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z), a date (2024-01-01) or a relative value (-30d, -8h, +1w)

created_before.description: Include IoCs created before this date. Supports an absolute datetime (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z), a date (2024-01-01) or a relative value (-30d, -8h, +1w)

modified_after.description: Include IoCs modified on or after this date. Supports an absolute datetime (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z), a date (2024-01-01) or a relative value (-30d, -8h, +1w)

modified_before.description: Include IoCs modified before this date. Supports an absolute datetime (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z), a date (2024-01-01) or a relative value (-30d, -8h, +1w)

sort.description: Date field and direction used to sort the fetched IoCs (default: last_seen_at:desc)

include_total_count.description: Fetch the exact count of the matching IoCs into the action summary. This increases the response time on large result sets

actions.description: Ingest Flashpoint alerts or compromised credentials into SOAR containers and artifacts

actions.verbose: The data source is selected by the 'Ingestion Type' asset configuration. Splunk SOAR permits one ingestion action per app, so ingesting both alerts and compromised credentials requires two asset configurations. A scheduled poll resumes from the saved checkpoint and writes a new one; POLL NOW honours the container count passed in by the platform and leaves the checkpoint untouched.
